title: UAR effective settings as read by ipfs mcp check-uar
description: The only settings shape check-uar accepts (ADR-0007). It is Kubo's normalized form of UAR's effective settings (mcp/uar/requests/CONFORMANCE.md item 8). check-uar reads it from the path pinned in uar-preflight.json, never from a guessed path. A response that does not validate (including the per-key record array UAR serves at GET /api/uar/settings at HEAD a7cb9729) is unreadable settings: check verify refuses the principal. Field presence rules: revision, llm and both embedders are required (missing means refuse); governance, native_tools and mcp_servers are the tool inventory (missing means write groups are withdrawn, HG-2). Unknown extra fields are ignored so a UAR release may return more.

revision.description: Changes whenever any value below changes. A string (hash) or a non-negative integer (counter).

enabled.description: Whether the governance gate is effectively enabled. false withdraws write groups.

shell_tools.description: Names of any other enabled shell-capable native tools. Non-empty withdraws write groups. Absent means none.

mcp_servers.description: Every MCP server UAR is configured with. Any entry that is not this ipfs mcp (an http entry whose URL is the /mcp route of the bound HTTP listen address) withdraws write groups. A stdio entry is never this ipfs mcp.

provider_host.description: Host (optionally with port) of the provider endpoint the effective value calls, or the literal local (in-process or loopback, no network) or disabled (not used). A remote host must be in the principal's egress_ack.
